name: hooks
description: Optional Bash-tool and workflow enforcement hooks for the agent plugin: no-bash (route Bash file-read/search to dedicated tools), no-absolute-paths, force-plan-mode, an auto-formatter, no-honest (Stop-event evidence-over-vouching nudge), no-idle-wait (Stop-event nudge to keep working while background tasks run), and no-tmp (blocks scratch files in the temp directory). Install to opt into enforcement. Requires agent@ronin-skills for the skills these hooks reference.
